name: Technical University of Denmark
about: DTU is a self-governing technical university founded in 1829, combining engineering and natural science with sustainability and work with industry. General Engineering is its current English undergraduate full degree, taught on the landscaped Lyngby campus north of Copenhagen. Ballerup is home to many of its Danish-taught BEng students.

languageOfInstruction.note: DTU states: "DTU currently offers one English-taught full degree BSc programme in General Engineering. All other undergraduate programmes are taught in Danish, but we offer a wide range of individual courses in English."

notes: Current undergraduate portfolio: one English full BSc at Lyngby; 2027-specific portfolio and annual dates require recheck before applications open.
Same-year IB results recipient is 173405; arrange through your coordinator before 1 June to satisfy both published wordings.
Course Results supplementation needs individual DTU confirmation because its A-plus-B wording differs from national exceptions.
Historic 2026 quota 1 cut-off 10.6 on the Danish 7-point scale is context, not a 2027 minimum or an offer prediction.

support.accessibility: Special educational support (SPS) for permanent functional impairments; contact the unit early because previous support is not transferred automatically: https://www.dtu.dk/english/education/undergraduate/general-engineering/admission-and-deadlines/special-educational-support-sps-
support.academic: Study Guidance helps with course planning, credit transfer, exemptions and regulations: https://www.dtu.dk/english/education/guidance-and-counselling
support.internationalStudents: International Student Services helps with exchange and administrative/cultural issues when new at DTU and in Denmark: https://www.dtu.dk/english/education/guidance-and-counselling

admissionRoutes.text: An overall assessment of motivation, maths and science results, relevant work or education, and other documented activities. Submit an English personal statement and CV.

levelRaise.text: Declare planned supplementary subjects and levels in your application. DTU permits at most two level raises after 5 July, for either quota.
levelRaise.timing: Upload passed supplementary exams through UnistartDTU by 1 September; annual rule, confirm for 2027. This does not itself make Course Results a qualifying general examination.
